description: Pinned checkpoint and sources for the verified native Windows YuE2 GPU audio example. Two consecutive FLACs passed technical delivery/decoding/tracing checks and user usability feedback. No weights are included; review upstream model terms before downloading or use.

model_terms.scope: The pinned repackaged and original model cards declare CC-BY-NC-4.0; these model terms remain separate from Packet Foundry code. These are evaluation trials.

models.provenance: Official Comfy-Org repackaged INT8 ConvRot YuE2 3B checkpoint, containing the autoregressive encoder, non-autoregressive diffusion model and audio VAE. No separate cover/transcription checkpoint is required by this text-to-music graph.
